wargear.name: Baronial heraldry
wargear.summary: A hundred years of victories painted across the faceplate and shoulder carapace, each one a promise to the Household.
wargear.text: A Knight equipped with Baronial heraldry adds 1 to its Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill Characteristics.

wargear.name: Sacristan's reliquary
wargear.summary: A locked casket of sacred oils, coolant-psalters and the ashes of former pilots, kept by a Sacristan who rides in the lee of the war machine.
wargear.text: A Knight equipped with a Sacristan's reliquary adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic. An Armiger equipped with a Sacristan's reliquary adds 1 to its Wounds Characteristic instead.

wargear.name: Heraldic Warhorn
wargear.summary: A hunting horn of silvered brass the length of a man, sounded from a Knight's shoulder to send the Household's levies forward.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Heraldic Warhorn has the Herald's Summons Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ablative Mantle
wargear.summary: Layered ceramite shingles hung over the carapace, built to burn away in place of the frame beneath.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Ablative Mantle has the Ablative Sacrifice Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gunnery Cantor
wargear.summary: A hooded cogitator-savant who chants firing solutions into the Knight's ear.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Gunnery Cantor has the Cantor's Lock Special Rule.

wargear.name: Oathmarker Beacon
wargear.summary: A standard-staff driven into the earth to mark ground the Household has sworn not to give up.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Oathmarker Beacon has the Oathkeeper Special Rule.

wargear.name: Honour-scourge
wargear.summary: A braided lash carried by the sergeant, for use on laggards and on those who flinch.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Honour-scourge has the Drill Discipline Special Rule.

wargear.name: Barony Signal Rockets
wargear.summary: A bandolier of coloured flares that tells the great engines where the Baron wants them to look.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Barony Signal Rockets has the Signal Flare Special Rule.

wargear.name: Furrow-plough
wargear.summary: A broad blade slung beneath the prow to clear hedgerows, wreckage and, if need be, men.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Furrow-plough has the Furrow-Plough Special Rule and subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

modifiers.text: Pressed levies who know the Household's justice: +1 LD, -1 CL.

rules.name: Scions Ahead of the Baron
rules.summary: The young scions ride out ahead of the Baron's banner, and the Baron watches from the ridge.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule may make a Set-up Move of up to 6". A Unit cannot end this move within 12" of any enemy Model.

rules.name: Declared Challenge
rules.summary: A Knight who names its challenge expects to see it answered.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Roll when it declares a Charge against an enemy Model with the Knight, Titan or Walker Type.

rules.name: Ledger of Vows
rules.summary: Every vow kept is entered in the ledger, and the ledger is long.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Model with this Special Rule makes an Auto-Repair roll, the Controlling Player may add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Sworn to the Baron
rules.summary: The levy swore to stand on the Baron's ground, and stand it will.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 3" of an Objective, it counts as a Scoring Unit and cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Herald's Summons
rules.summary: A long brass note carries over the field, and the levies surge forward.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Controlling Player's Movement Phase, a Model with this Special Rule may sound its horn. Until the end of that Battle Turn, every friendly Unit within 12" of that Model adds 2" to the distance it moves when it Rushes.

rules.name: Ablative Sacrifice
rules.summary: The mantle burns away so that the frame beneath need not.
rules.text: The first time in each battle that a Model with this Special Rule would lose a Hull Point (or, if it has a Wounds Characteristic, a Wound) as the result of a Shooting Attack, that loss is ignored.

rules.name: Cantor's Lock
rules.summary: The firing solution is chanted until the gun cannot miss.
rules.text: Once in each of the Controlling Player's Shooting Phases, a Model with this Special Rule may choose one of its ranged Weapons. That Weapon adds 1 to its Hit Tests until the end of that Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Oathkeeper
rules.summary: A Household does not give up sworn ground.
rules.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is within 6" of an Objective, it has the Line (1) Special Rule. A Model with this Special Rule cannot Rush in a Battle Turn in which it begins its move within 6" of an Objective.

rules.name: Drill Discipline
rules.summary: The sergeant's lash keeps the line straight and the laggards moving.
rules.text: While the Sergeant of a Unit with this Special Rule remains in play, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when the Unit takes a Morale Check. If a Unit with this Special Rule fails a Morale Check, the Controlling Player must also remove one Model other than the Sergeant as a casualty.

rules.name: Signal Flare
rules.summary: Coloured flares show the great engines where to look.
rules.text: Once per battle, in the Controlling Player's Shooting Phase, one friendly Knight or Armiger within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the Hit Tests of one Shooting Attack it makes against an enemy Unit that is visible to the Unit that includes the Model with this Special Rule.

rules.name: Furrow-Plough
rules.summary: The plough clears the road, and whatever stands upon it.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule ignores Dangerous Terrain Tests. It subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

armyRules.name: Liege-Sworn Retinue
armyRules.flavor: The Household's levies fight better under the Baron's eye and worse without it.
benefits: A Militia Unit within 12" of a friendly Knight or Armiger adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when it takes a Morale Check.
drawbacks: When a friendly Knight is removed as a casualty, every Militia Unit within 12" of it must pass a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Heraldic Pride
armyRules.flavor: A Knight cannot let an insult to its colours pass.
benefits: A Knight adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic.
drawbacks: If an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker is visible and within a Knight's Charge reach at the start of the Assault Phase, the Controlling Player must declare a Charge with that Knight against it, or the Knight must pass a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Ward of the Elders
armyRules.flavor: Armigers are the Household's heirs, and the Knights guard them jealously.
benefits: An Armiger within 6" of a friendly Knight cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status.
drawbacks: While no friendly Knight remains on the battlefield, an Armiger subtracts 2 from its Leadership and Cool Characteristics.
armyRules.condition: when no friendly Knight is on the battlefield

rites.name: The Armiger Ward
rites.flavor: The young scions go first, and the Baron watches from the ridge.
benefits: Armiger Helverins, Warglaives and Moiraxes may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Armigers gain Scions Ahead of the Baron: after both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn, each may make a Set-up Move of up to 6".
limitations: At least three Armigers are required.
No Acastus Knights, and no more than one Lord of War.
Every Lord of War must start the battle in Reserves.

modifiers.text: The Armiger Ward: Line (1), Scions Ahead of the Baron.

rites.name: The Lists of Honour
rites.flavor: A Knight who will not name his challenge is only a tank with a coat of arms.
benefits: Every Knight gains Fear (1), adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic and gains Declared Challenge: it adds 1 to its Charge Rolls against an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker.
limitations: At least one Knight is required.
No Recon, no Support and no Acastus Knights.
A Knight cannot Rush while a visible enemy Knight, Titan or Walker is within 12".

modifiers.text: The Lists of Honour: Fear (1), +1 WS, Declared Challenge.

require.note: A Knight must issue the challenge.

rites.name: The Sacristan's Vigil
rites.flavor: Each Knight is carried to war on a ledger of vows, and the ledger is long.
benefits: Every Knight adds 2 to its Hull Points Characteristic and gains Ledger of Vows: once per battle it may add 1 to one Auto-Repair roll.
limitations: Every Knight subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic.
No more than two Lords of War.

modifiers.text: The Sacristan's Vigil: +2 HP, -2 M, Ledger of Vows.

rites.name: Muster of the Free Levy
rites.flavor: The Baron calls his tithe, and every town on his world sends its sons.
benefits: Grenadier Troops may fill Troops slots; Grenadier and Levy Troops gain Line (1).
Militia gain Sworn to the Baron: while within 3" of an Objective, a Militia Unit counts as a Scoring Unit and cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.
limitations: At least two Infantry Troops are required.
No more than one Lord of War, and no Armiger Moirax.

modifiers.text: Muster of the Free Levy: Line (1).
Muster of the Free Levy: Sworn to the Baron.

require.note: Bring at least two Infantry Troops.
